title: •Sebulba
caption: •Sebulba (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}: any combat vehicle. Brisky Morning Munchen is canceled. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per turn, if any podrace total > 0, may take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.
lore: Bad tempered Dug from Pixelito. He was about to turn Jar Jar into orange goo, until Anakin intervened.

notes: Group: Everything else. Unique. Bottom-half slip. POWER 3 / ABILITY 2 / third box blank; deploy 3 / forfeit 5; icon column pilot (DS helmet), warrior. Leading DS pilot-power icon + '2: any combat vehicle.' → {pilot:2}: any combat vehicle (stub 'Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots: any combat vehicle'). Credits below the text box: 'Original concept by Garrett Larson' left, 'Minnesota States Sealed 2005' right. Alien disc; ring icons on the printed card: Tatooine sphere + Episode I → ring_icons ['episode1']. Printed POWER 4 (slip 3). Lore matches the scan; copyright 2001 line read on the scan. 350 px scan only. Modern: VB5-D-sebulba-pre.gif (Virtual Block 5) — same rules but the sentences are reordered ('Once per turn…' before 'Draws one battle destiny…'). Not V11-D-sebulba (that is Virtual Set 11's different Sebulba (V)). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
